annotations.title: Get Google index status for this site

description: Returns whether Google's index holds this site's pages, when the owner has connected Google Search Console. Google's index is what AI Overviews, AI Mode and Gemini grounding read — the Google counterpart of "Bing's index is what ChatGPT search reads". Three tiers share Google's 2,000-inspections/day budget (there is no bulk index report): a WATCHLIST (homepage, busiest pages, newest posts — every answer in rows) checked daily; PROMOTED PROBLEMS — pages any check found unhealthy join the daily check (stalest first, capped at watched.promotedDaily) until they heal; and a WHOLE-SITE ROTATION walking every published URL in daily slices — healthy pages become the site counts, every problem (watched or not) appears in site.problems, and a page that just healed announces in site.healed for about two days before going quiet. On sites small enough the rotation covers everything every day; site.cycleDays states the honest cadence. site.problems ships a bounded, every-bucket share of the problem rows; to walk ALL of one state's pages, pass problemsState (a stateKey) and page with problemsPage — site.problems then holds exactly that page of 50, in a stable order, while every count stays complete (pages = ceil(site.problemStates[state] / 50)). Presence only, no traffic (read-search-performance has the traffic). Returns connected=false with empty rows when no key is connected.

problemsPage.description: Optional: 1-based page of 50 within problemsState; ignored without it. Beyond the last page, site.problems is empty.

problemsState.description: Optional: a problem bucket (error | canonical | unknown | discovered | crawled | redirect | blocked | other) — site.problems becomes one page of exactly that state's rows.

url.description: Optional: ONE page to answer for, absolute or site-relative. Answers from the stored record only — no live call to Google, no quota spent — so use it to ask "is THIS page in?" without walking rows. Adds `lookup` to the response; the rest of the payload is unchanged.

name: agentimus-read-google-index

checkedAt.description: Unix time of the newest sweep; 0 = never checked.

connected.description: False = Google Search Console is not connected; rows is then empty.

canonicalDiffers.description: Watchlist pages where Google chose a different canonical URL than the one checked.

errors.description: Watchlist pages whose inspection itself failed.

notOnGoogle.description: Watchlist pages Google confirms are NOT in its index — each row's state says why in Google's own words.

onGoogle.description: Watchlist pages Google confirms are in its index.

lastError.description: The most recent sweep failure, empty after a clean sweep.

canonicalDiffers.description: Google treats a different URL as this page's real address.

error.description: This row's own inspection failure, if any.

fetchState.description: How Google's last fetch of the page went, e.g. SUCCESSFUL, SOFT_404, NOT_FOUND, SERVER_ERROR; empty when unknown.

googleCanonical.description: The canonical Google chose; empty when unknown.

gscLink.description: Deep link to this URL's inspection in Search Console — where "Request indexing" lives (that button has no API).

healedAt.description: Unix time this page turned from problem to healthy; 0 = not recently healed. Healed pages announce in site.healed for about two days, then go quiet.

healedFrom.description: The problem bucket this page healed FROM (same keys as stateKey); empty when not recently healed.

inSitemap.description: Whether a sitemap Google knows lists this URL — false on an unindexed page means nobody told Google it exists.

inspectedAt.description: Unix time THIS row was last inspected — older than checkedAt means a quota-cut sweep kept its previous answer.

lastCrawl.description: Unix time Googlebot last visited; 0 = never.

noindex.description: A noindex tag or header asks Google to skip this URL.

openedAt.description: Unix time the OWNER last opened this URL in Search Console, or 0. A record of their click and nothing more: Google keeps no memory of "indexing requested" and no API exposes a pending state, so never read this as "indexing was requested" or "Google is working on it".

postId.description: 0 when the URL maps to no post (the homepage, an archive).

reason.description: Why this page was checked: "home", "new" (newest posts), "busy" (busiest in Google) or "site" (the whole-site rotation).

referrers.description: Pages Google knows link to this URL (at least — Google caps what it reports); 0 on an unindexed page names the other discovery gap: nothing points here.

richIssues.description: Rich-result issues Google reports on this page; 0 = none.

richTypes.description: Rich-result types Google detected, comma-separated; empty = none.

robotsBlocked.description: robots.txt closes this URL to Google.

state.description: Google's own coverage sentence, e.g. "Crawled - currently not indexed".

stateKey.description: The problem bucket this row counts under: error | canonical | unknown | discovered | crawled | redirect | blocked | other; groups and site.problemStates share these keys.

verdict.description: "pass" = on Google, "neutral"/"fail" = not on Google, "" = not checked yet.

status.description: Only present when `url` was asked for. found = a stored answer is in `row`; unchecked = this site's page, no answer stored yet (site.cycleDays says when the rotation reaches it); foreign = not a URL on this site, so it is never checked here.

url.description: The URL as asked, resolved against the site when it was site-relative.

pausedAt.description: Unix time the owner stopped the current sweep with Cancel; 0 = nothing is stopped. While this is set the pending pages are waiting on a deliberate restart or the daily check — nothing is working through them.

pending.description: Pages of the current sweep still waiting — the sweep runs in short budgeted chunks so no web request runs long. 0 = the last sweep finished; rows not yet reached carry their previous answers.

property.description: The Search Console property the answers come from.

quotaHit.description: True when Google's daily inspection budget ran out mid-sweep — unreached rows keep their last good answers (see each row's inspectedAt).

problemsTotal.description: Problem pages found across the site in total — `problems` is capped at 50 rows, this count is not. Watched pages with problems are included.

totalUrls.description: Every published URL plus the homepage — what "the whole site" means here; 0 until the first rotation ran.

checkedAt.description: Unix time the registered-sitemaps list was last read from Search Console; 0 = never looked yet (says nothing about the site).

liveUrl.description: The sitemap URL this site actually serves today — the address worth registering.

errors.description: Errors Google reports for this sitemap's contents.

lastRead.description: Unix time Google last downloaded it; 0 = never. A registration whose live file moved keeps its old date forever — the silent way sitemaps die.

path.description: The sitemap URL as registered in Search Console — possibly years ago, possibly an address nothing serves anymore.

pending.description: Submitted but not yet processed by Google.

submitted.description: URLs the sitemap declared at Google's last read.

warnings.description: Warnings Google reports for this sitemap's contents.

busiest.description: How many busiest-in-Google pages the watchlist covers at most.

dailyCap.description: Google's documented inspections-per-day budget for the property.

newest.description: How many newest posts the watchlist covers at most.

promotedDaily.description: How many problem pages join the daily check at most (stalest answer first) — the rest keep the rotation cadence until their turn.

rotationDaily.description: How many whole-site URLs the rotation inspects per day.
